scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && python -m ruff check services/api services/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && python -m mypy services/api/app services/worker/worker.py
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace @lili/geometry && npm run test --workspace @lili/ai-router
